title: Privacy first cookie consent banner
when: The user wants a cookie or tracking consent banner where rejecting is as easy as accepting.
prompt:
Goal: A non blocking consent banner that loads no optional script before a choice and lets users change their mind later.
Steps:
1. <section aria-labelledby="cc-title"> fixed at the bottom: heading, two plain sentences, the policy link; no overlay on the page.
2. Three buttons of equal size and style: Reject all, Accept all, Choose; Choose reveals labeled category checkboxes, essential checked and disabled, others unchecked.
3. Store { version, date, categories } as JSON in localStorage, reads and writes in try and catch, JSON.parse guarded.
4. Optional scripts wait as <script type="text/plain" data-category="analytics"> and run by creating a new script element only after consent.
5. A Cookie settings link in the footer reopens the banner; bump the version when categories change.
Quality bar:
- Reject takes one click, like Accept.
- Purposes in plain words (Measure visits).
- At most a third of a phone screen.
Pitfalls:
- Pre-checked optional categories.
- Tracking that runs before the choice.
- A close X that silently counts as acceptance.
Verify:
- [ ] Reject all and Accept all look the same.
- [ ] Every checkbox has a label.
- [ ] No optional script runs without stored consent.
- [ ] Storage and JSON.parse are guarded.
Output: Banner markup before the closing body tag, consent.css and consent.js.

examples.input: banner de cookies LGPD com opcao de recusar
examples.output: bottom section with Reject all, Accept all and Choose, analytics script activated only after consent, footer link to reopen
